name: Competitor Watch
focus: Pricing, positioning and saturation for priority candidates
summary: Fresh scan changes portfolio priority: hard-bottom dog-seat extenders are already a real EU price ladder; windshield umbrella shades are too commoditized for HERO treatment; Kit Muda Cero still has system-level whitespace but must beat stronger Spain-facing trust and delivery standards.
material_change_reason: Revise hard-bottom dog-cover saturation to medium-high, demote windshield umbrella to seasonal cross-sell/HOLD, and keep Muda Cero at 39.90 EUR only if the complete 3-tool routine clearly justifies the premium over strong single-tool offers.

findings.change: SoftPet adds a Spain-facing 19.99 EUR single-tool benchmark with displayed 24/48h shipping, 100-day trial and 13,560 reviews; Uproot continues aggressive multi-buy pricing and a 60-day guarantee.
findings.positioning: Sell a verified 3-step pet-to-home routine, not another hair remover. Explain coat and textile limits.
findings.pricing_handoff: Keep 39.90 EUR as first test only if real demonstrations make the 3-tool system obviously more useful than a ~19.99 EUR single tool.

findings.candidate: Hard-bottom dog car cover / backseat extender
findings.change: Current EU/DTC ladder spans about 52.99-57.90 EUR at VEVOR, 69.95 EUR at Phaedra/Zoospot, 79.95 EUR at FluffyPuppy and above 100 EUR at several specialists. Phaedra already uses exact dimensions, measurement warnings and wash/fit detail.
findings.positioning: Differentiate on fit confidence: exact usable floor dimensions, how to measure, belt access, split-seat use, cleaning and honest exclusions.
findings.pricing_handoff: Keep 59.90-69.90 EUR test band. Above 79.90 EUR enters stronger warranty/proof territory.

findings.change: Reismonkey is merchandising a 3-piece compression set around 34.99 EUR with 1-4 day delivery, 2-year guarantee and 30-day returns; WAYKS starts around 20 EUR and already uses clean/dirty separation.
findings.positioning: Do not promote a generic multi-piece set. Keep only as TEST/CROSS-SELL unless sourcing unlocks a much better use-case or margin.

findings.change: Marketplace pricing now spans roughly 5.80 EUR to 25.35 EUR across working umbrella shades, compressing DTC CAC headroom.
findings.pricing_handoff: HOLD for paid acquisition; consider only as summer cross-sell if landed cost is exceptionally low and sizing is explicit.

opportunities.title: Muda Cero: sell the whole routine, not another glove
opportunities.detail: Use real 3-step demonstrations, compatibility guidance and Spain-grade shipping/returns trust to justify 39.90 EUR.

opportunities.title: Dog cover: fit-first mid-market wedge
opportunities.detail: Target 59.90-69.90 EUR with measurement UX, exact dimensions, belt/split-seat compatibility and cleaning proof.

opportunities.title: Protect HERO budget from commodities
opportunities.detail: Packing cubes stay TEST/CROSS-SELL and windshield umbrellas move to seasonal CROSS-SELL/HOLD unless economics materially change.

creative_offer: Make Muda Cero visibly justify its premium versus ~19.99 EUR single-tool offers through three distinct jobs and real demos.
Make vehicle-fit confidence the dog-cover core story.
Downgrade packing cubes and windshield umbrella from HERO priority.
finance_profit: Keep Muda Cero 39.90 EUR as first test pending full landed cost.
Model dog cover at 59.90 and 69.90 EUR; treat >79.90 EUR as premium territory.
No paid-acquisition budget for windshield umbrellas at present.
orchestrator: Muda Cero remains leader but trust/delivery proof is now table stakes.
Hard-bottom dog cover remains second HERO candidate with saturation revised upward to medium-high.
Demote windshield umbrella to seasonal cross-sell/HOLD; packing cubes remain TEST.

events.title: Spain-facing pet-hair competition strengthened
events.detail: A 19.99 EUR local-facing single-tool offer with fast-shipping and long-trial messaging raises the trust bar for Muda Cero.

events.title: Hard-bottom saturation revised upward
events.detail: Multiple EU/DTC extenders create a clear 52.99 EUR to 131.11 EUR price ladder; fit guidance is becoming table stakes.

events.title: Commodity candidates demoted
events.detail: Packing cubes show stronger branded competition near 20-35 EUR, while windshield umbrella pricing reaches single digits.
